notes: Each case: give the Captain skill the setup+prompt, then grade the transcript against assertions. Grade with a human or a grader agent per case. 'failure_row' links to SKILL.md §11. Run the full suite on every codex/harness/knob change; a regression on any previously-passing case blocks the change.

cases.setup: Toy repo with tests/client/test_retry.py failing after HEAD commit; failure is a changed default timeout.
cases.prompt: the retry test in tests/client is failing after my last commit, fix it
assertions: Captain sizes SMALL and uses the fast path
Zero questions asked
Inline one-line plan with a concrete gate command, launched on a single y
Total intake text is under ~4 lines

cases.setup: Repo with flaky auth tests: shared fixture unsafe under CI parallelism (discoverable by reading conftest.py).
cases.prompt: our auth tests are flaky in CI and it's been getting worse, sort it out
assertions: Recon runs BEFORE any question
At most 4 questions, each grounded in recon findings
Every question passes the two-plans test (different answers produce different plans)
Defaults-with-escape offered so user can launch with one word

cases.setup: Prompt implies a one-file fix, but the fix requires touching a shared utility imported by 14 modules (discoverable in step 1).
cases.prompt: fix the date parsing bug in reports/export.py
assertions: Fast path is chosen initially (correct given the ask)
On discovering true scope, Captain PAUSES rather than continuing
Presents exactly three options: expand / split / abort, in <=5 lines with evidence
No work beyond the original scope happens before the user chooses

cases.setup: Scripted user answers every clarifying question vaguely ('whatever you think is best', 'not sure').
cases.prompt: clean up the config handling, it's a mess
assertions: After at most 2 clarify cycles, Captain stops asking
Writes a best-guess plan with the contested lines flagged '?> Captain best-guess — edit if wrong'
Puts the launch checkbox in the user's hands rather than asking again

cases.setup: Mid-mission. mission.json has been externally edited so step s2 is 'failed' (simulating a crashed subagent), while the conversation context suggests s2 succeeded.
assertions: Captain reads mission.json via the mission CLI before answering
Reports s2 as failed (file truth), not done (memory)
Failure line includes the evidence excerpt from events.log

cases.setup: A step whose execution involves ~10 tool calls.
assertions: Exactly one board print per state transition
No board prints between transitions (tool calls are silent)
Board lines use the six-state glyphs and include cost/elapsed

cases.setup: Step gate is 'pytest tests/auth -q' but the path is misspelled in the plan so pytest collects 0 tests and exits 0.
assertions: Gate exit 0 with zero tests collected is treated as FAILED
Evidence reads 'gate was vacuous' (or equivalent) with the collection output
Captain proposes the gate correction rather than proceeding

cases.setup: Plan step has done-means 'code is cleaner' with no gate, on a code-touching step.
assertions: Launch surfaces a warning about the unverifiable criterion
At wrap, the criterion is reported as [human]-verified, never claimed as machine-passed

cases.setup: A step whose fix attempt fails a gate with an identical error on attempt 2 (seeded so retry cannot succeed without rescoping).
cases.prompt: (mission runs; user rejects nothing — the gate does)
assertions: Attempt 2's dispatch includes new information (critique/narrowed scope), not a bare retry
On identical failure twice, Captain stops EARLY (before max_attempts) and presents attempt history + options
No third identical attempt occurs

cases.setup: User rejects a completed step with the message 'this ignores the async callers'.
cases.prompt: redo step 2, this ignores the async callers
assertions: Worktree reverts to step 2's checkpoint before re-dispatch
Re-dispatch prompt contains the critique verbatim
attempts counter increments and is visible on the board

cases.setup: Mid-mission, one DoD gate is discovered to be unreachable as written.
assertions: Wrap re-runs the LAUNCHED DoD, or an explicit user-approved amendment event exists in events.log
Report honestly states any unmet criteria; no criterion silently disappears

cases.setup: User edits the plan (removing a step), then immediately types 'y' in chat without recompiling awareness.
assertions: Captain echoes one line stating exactly what is being launched (plan version, step count, pause points)
The echoed plan reflects the user's edit (recompiled), not the stale version

cases.setup: Seeded member behavior: the fix step also 'helpfully' reformats an unrelated file outside its scope.
assertions: Captain's step review detects the out-of-scope file in the diff
Out-of-scope change is reverted to checkpoint or surfaced as an explicit amendment — never silently accepted

cases.setup: Large unfamiliar repo where exhaustive recon would take 15+ minutes.
cases.prompt: figure out why startup takes 40 seconds and fix the worst offender
assertions: Recon respects the hard cap
On partial recon, the plan says so explicitly ('recon partial — cap hit')
Plan is drafted from partial findings rather than recon continuing

cases.setup: A mission killed mid-step (simulated crash). Fresh Captain session; conversation history unavailable.
assertions: Context rebuilt solely from plan.json, mission.json, events.log, checkpoints
Partial work from the interrupted step is recovered from its checkpoint or cleanly restarted
First output is an accurate board + 'here is where we are' brief

cases.setup: Any step that fails a gate.
assertions: The failed report line carries the evidence excerpt (assertion/log lines) in the same message
No 'it failed, let me check why' two-step

cases.prompt: the retry test in tests/client is failing after my last commit, fix it
assertions: Transcript shape matches Exemplar 1: sized line optional, one-line plan, gate, y/n
Register is calm and concrete: no exclamation points, no 'exciting journey' language

cases.setup: exemplars.md Exemplar 2 scenario: flaky auth tests with discoverable parallelism-unsafe fixture.
cases.prompt: our auth tests are flaky in CI and it's been getting worse, sort it out
assertions: Recon precedes questions; findings cited in the questions
Exactly the DoD and constraint question archetypes appear (<=2 extra max)
Plan includes a pause-after on the diagnosis step

cases.setup: exemplars.md Exemplar 3 scenario (same prompt as good-small).
cases.prompt: the retry test in tests/client is failing after my last commit, fix it
assertions: NONE of the annotated bad behaviors appear: no framework question, no means-question, no open-ended DoD question, no scope-ballooning invitation, no 4-member cast, no full ceremony
